text:
maria: quick heads-up — kicking off Lytica adapter (LoRA v3) bring-up on int8 runtime. Running a focused quick-eval pack (invoices + small tables).

raj: awesome. remember last time we had subtle token id shifts for currency symbols. did you run the tokenizer alignment?

maria: yep. used infra/token_align.py against their tokenizer bundle. cmd:
```
python infra/token_align.py --src models/base-lytica/tokenizer.json --dst customers/lytica/tokenizer.json --out tmp/lyt_token_map.json
```

ci-bot: queued: smoke/1723456789-lytica-int8 (priority: high)

oliver: after ~20 prompts embeddings look consistent, but noticed invoice total extraction drops ~2% vs fp16 baseline.

sara: customer flagged amount hallucinations in staging — they need exact totals.

maria: saw 3/50 failure cases where sign or cents were wrong. Trying a couple of runtime tweaks: disabling kv cache prefill and reducing group_size to 128. Proposed quant config:
```
quantization: int8
group_size: 128
act_order: symmetric
kv_cache_prefill: false
```

raj: also try my token_fix branch (refs: token_fix/lyt-compat) — it patches an off-by-one token map for the currency glyphs.

ci-bot: smoke started -> smoke/1723456789-lytica-int8: 0/50 complete.

maria: running quick eval: 
```
python tools/run_quick_eval.py --model base-lytica --lora customers/lytica/lytica-lora-v3 --quant int8 --prompts eval_packs/lytica_invoices.min.json --out /tmp/lyt_eval_1723456789.json --batch-size 4
```

maria: results (50 prompts): 47 pass, 3 amount regressions (cases 12, 27, 44). p95 latency +12% vs fp16, estimated token compute cost -45%. Failing snippet:
```
input: "Items: $12.99, $3.50, $5.00. Total?"
expected_fp16: "$21.49"
int8_output: "-$21.49"  # sign inverted
```

oliver: sign inversion suggests token ordering or byte-interpretation problem, not just quant noise. token_fix might help. If not, we should route invoice endpoints to fp16 for the canary.

sara: customer ok with canary if invoice routes fallback to fp16. include that in rollout notes.

maria: plan: 1) rerun with raj/token_fix + kv_cache_prefill=false; 2) if green, deploy canary (10% traffic) with enforced fp16 fallback for invoice route; 3) attach eval artifacts + failing samples to ticket and CS.

raj: add a small unit test for currency token sequences to catch regressions in CI.

maria: added to my todo, opening infra/rollout/1723456789 with attachments. tagging @sara for the customer comms. :memo:

sara: will draft message and canary plan. :thumbsup: please ping when the ticket has artifacts.

ci-bot: smoke complete: 50/50. summary: 47 OK, 3 regressions (amount parsing). artifacts: /ci/artifacts/smoke/1723456789/summary.json

maria: closing thread here; will update rollout ticket with results and the canary + fallback config.
